svg.title: Event poster: establish importance through scale
svg.desc: The same printed event poster, greenhouse photograph, crop, paper, lighting, typography, wording and positions appear twice. Only the specified font sizes change: title 32 to 76, date 32 to 36, and details 32 to 24.
svg.metadata: Original Patternverse teaching example. Photographic sources generated with the built-in image_gen tool; fictional events, businesses and report data. Both variants reuse identical image bytes. SVG composition and type are authored deterministically; only elements marked data-scale differ.
svg.text: Same imagery, copy, crop, color, position and lighting. Only scale changes.
